sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Sector breadth remains narrow with only 2 of 11 groups all-green, anchored by sustained leadership in Technology alongside resilient Energy momentum.

Technology and Energy continue to command the top of the market. Technology boasts near-perfect momentum (0.950, rank 2) with sustained top-3 performance across the 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons, while Energy maintains the #1 YTD rank with 0.783 momentum. Meanwhile, Communication Services and Industrials showed incremental rotation higher, each gaining one rank over the last five sessions.

Laggards continue to weigh on broader market participation. Real Estate anchored the bottom of the table, falling one spot to rank 9 with market-low momentum of 0.117, accompanied by weakness in Utilities (0.267 momentum) and Consumer Cyclical (0.333 momentum, rank 11). Healthcare also slipped, dropping one spot to rank 5.

## Strength
- **Narrow all-green breadth:** Only 2 of 11 sectors—Technology (0.950 momentum) and Communication Services (0.583 momentum)—remain positive across all measured timeframes (week, month, quarter, half, YTD).
- **Technology dominance:** Technology is the sole sector showing sustained strength, holding a top-3 rank across the 1-, 3-, and 6-month windows while maintaining a 0.950 momentum score.
- **Energy leadership:** Energy holds the #1 YTD rank with the second-highest momentum score on the board at 0.783.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Upward movers:** Communication Services gained +1 spot to reach rank 8 (momentum 0.583), and Industrials rose +1 spot to rank 4 (momentum 0.650).
- **Downward movers:** Real Estate slipped -1 spot to rank 9 with anemic 0.117 momentum, while Healthcare fell -1 spot to rank 5 (momentum 0.500).
- **Momentum leaders:** Technology (0.950), Energy (0.783), and Industrials (0.650) lead the market.
- **Momentum laggards:** Real Estate (0.117), Utilities (0.267), and Consumer Cyclical (0.333, rank 11) remain the primary drags.

## Divergences
- **Communication Services rank vs. breadth:** While qualifying as one of only two all-green sectors, Communication Services sits at a relatively low YTD rank of 8 despite its 0.583 momentum score.
- **Defensive split:** Industrials pushed higher to rank 4 (momentum 0.650), whereas defensive sectors like Utilities (momentum 0.267) and Consumer Defensive (momentum 0.350, rank 6) remain pinned in the bottom half of momentum scores.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Hardware, energy, and distribution dominance persists with 14 all-green groups, while healthcare and specialty pharma face sharp near-term rank unwinds.

Tech hardware and traditional energy continue to dictate market leadership. Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing alongside electronics, semiconductors, and communication equipment demonstrate unbroken positive performance across all timeframes. Meanwhile, defensive rotation is emerging selectively via regulated utilities and energy inputs, even as software groups attempt to climb from deeply discounted levels.

Conversely, broad healthcare segments are fading rapidly. Severe multi-spot drops across specialty drugmakers, pharma retail, and biotech reflect aggressive capital reallocation away from the space. Similarly, consumer-facing groups like department stores and lodging are beginning to lose rank momentum despite elevated baseline scores.

## Strength
- **Sustained Hardware and Energy:** Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (momentum 0.991, rank_ytd 2) and Electronics & Computer Distribution (momentum 0.966, rank_ytd 3) lead 14 all-green industry groups.
- **Semiconductor Ecosystem Resilient:** Communication Equipment (momentum 0.960, rank_ytd 6) and Semiconductors (momentum 0.936, rank_ytd 8) hold top-36 positions across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons.
- **Industrial Anchors:** Copper (momentum 0.86), Marine Shipping (momentum 0.88), and Scientific & Technical Instruments (momentum 0.90) remain fully green across week, month, quarter, half, and YTD frames.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Top 5-Session Surges:** Utilities - Regulated Water gained +18 spots (rank 51, momentum 0.69), Uranium climbed +16 spots (rank 96, momentum 0.41), and Aerospace & Defense rose +15 spots (rank 72, momentum 0.63).
- **Severe Short-Term Drawdowns:** Drug Manufacturers - Specialty & Generic tumbled -34 spots (rank 116, momentum 0.36), Pharmaceutical Retailers dropped -24 spots (rank 129, momentum 0.32), and Biotechnology slid -16 spots (rank 45, momentum 0.48).
- **Persistent Momentum Laggards:** Bottom performers remain pinned at the base, led downward by Advertising Agencies (momentum 0.024, rank_ytd 144) and REIT - Mortgage (momentum 0.048, rank_ytd 131).

## Divergences
- **Fading High-Momentum Groups:** Diagnostics & Research (momentum 0.74) and Department Stores (momentum 0.64) each dropped -12 spots over the past 5 sessions, signaling distribution despite high historical scores.
- **Early-Stage Turnarounds:** Low-momentum groups pushing sharply higher in 5-day rank include Uranium (+16 spots, momentum 0.41), Coking Coal (+12 spots, momentum 0.50), and Utilities - Diversified (+9 spots, momentum 0.46).
